audit_scope: LLM-as-a-Judge calibration split FEASIBILITY audit only. No judge run, no judge prompt written, no human labels or gold data changed, no experiment rerun, no significance testing, no dev/holdout split created or frozen.

family_forced_additional_exposed_questio.q001: shares question_family_id 'mism_normal_courseload' with q010 (given-exposed); q001 and q010 are the ONLY two questions in the entire 30-question pilot that share a family.

q021.evidence: Human Notes on response_ids R025 (treatment) and R060 (control) use verbatim-identical calibration language: 'Human-reviewed calibration label: this is a pure refusal on an answerable question after retrieval returned no chunks. Task Completion and Completeness fail... Correctness, Faithfulness, Citation Validity, and Citation Support are N/A. Final GAS fails.' This is a GENERAL rule formulated for a class of cases (zero-hit false refusal on an answerable question) and applied identically across q021 and q025 -- evaluation-rule refinement, not routine per-instance grading.

q025.evidence: Same verbatim calibration rule as q021, on response_ids R016 (treatment) and R035 (control). See q021 evidence.

q004.evidence: Human Notes on R051 (control) and R059 (treatment): 'Draft grade: the answer gives only the MISM-BIDA structure and never provides the MISM 108-core/54-elective side needed for the requested comparison.' This question was also the repeated worked example for the 'retrieval-limited failure' category used to design Verifier Prompt v2 (pattern E in that task) and was independently re-inspected as a named development case in the v1->v2 and v2->v2.1 comparison tasks across this project's history.

rubric_exposure.not_flagged_as_exposed: The remaining 24 questions with Human Notes (q008, q009, q022, q023 among others) carry only routine, rubric-CONSISTENT annotation rationale (applying already-frozen definitions to a specific case) with no evidence of formulating or revising a general evaluation rule. Per instruction, these are NOT automatically treated as exposed merely because they were human-annotated.

task_completion.can_validate_independently: NO if candidate exposure is honored (recommended) -- both fail families trace to the same rubric-development note. MARGINAL (2 thin families, same failure mode: zero-hit false refusal) if only the given mandatory list is honored.

correctness.can_validate_independently: NO -- the only Correctness FAIL in the entire 60-row dataset belongs to a mandatory rubric-exposed family. An independent holdout cannot validate this axis at all.

completeness.can_validate_independently: PARTIALLY / MARGINAL -- only q002 (family mism_curriculum_requirements) is not exposed by any evidence found. A single family cannot simultaneously appear in both judge_dev and holdout, so at most one side ever sees this failure type from a genuinely independent source.

faithfulness.can_validate_independently: NO -- zero Faithfulness FAIL examples exist anywhere in the 60-row dataset (Control or Treatment, exposed or not). Failure-detection ability for this axis cannot be validated from this dataset at all, regardless of split design.

citation_validity.can_validate_independently: PARTIALLY / MARGINAL -- exactly one family (q013) carries every Citation Validity FAIL in the dataset, and it is not currently rubric-exposed. But a single family can only be placed on ONE side of a dev/holdout split -- whichever side does not receive it has zero Citation Validity FAIL examples. Described as 'primarily deterministic' in the audit brief, but even a rule-based checker's agreement with human judgment on the boundary case it represents cannot be independently confirmed with only one example.

citation_support.note: IDENTICAL fail source to Citation Validity (same question, q013). The dataset has never observed a case where Citation Validity and Citation Support fail INDEPENDENTLY of each other (e.g., a valid citation that fails to support its claim, or vice versa) -- these two axes are conceptually distinct but empirically undifferentiated in this pilot.
citation_support.can_validate_independently: PARTIALLY / MARGINAL -- same single-family constraint as Citation Validity, and additionally this pilot cannot demonstrate a judge's ability to tell the two axes apart.

final_gas.can_validate_independently: PARTIALLY / MARGINAL -- only 2 of 8 GAS-FAIL-carrying families (q002, q013) are independent of rubric exposure, and they represent only 2 of the several distinct underlying failure MODES observed (completeness-gap, citation-mismatch). The false-refusal, scenario-specific-reasoning, and retrieval-limited-comparison failure modes have zero independent representation.

correct_abstention.can_validate_independently: NO -- zero FAIL examples exist; all 5 unanswerable questions were correctly abstained in both arms. A judge's ability to CATCH a genuine false-answer-on-unanswerable-question cannot be validated from this dataset at all.

unsupported_answer.can_validate_independently: NO -- identical situation to Correct Abstention; zero fabrication examples exist to validate detection against.

family_level_audit_summary.note: Full per-family detail (question_ids, answerable composition, Control/Treatment GAS, axes with FAIL/N/A) is available in eval/annotation/pilot_30q_v2.1/human_eval_metrics_v2.1.json cross-referenced with eval/annotation/final_human_labels_v2.1.csv; omitted here in full (29 entries) for file size -- see the accompanying .md for the condensed version of families carrying any FAIL signal.
family_level_audit_summary.20_10_headcount_arithmetic: Numerically possible: 9 mandatory+candidate exposed questions must go to judge_dev; the remaining 21 clean questions can split ~11/10 to reach an approximately 20 dev / 10 holdout total. This is a HEADCOUNT-ONLY feasibility check and does NOT by itself establish that the holdout would contain meaningful failure examples -- see axis_failure_support_audit above.

feasibility_assessment.A_judge_development_feasible: FEASIBLE. 30 questions x 2 arms = 60 labeled responses, with real (if concentrated) FAIL signal on Task Completion, Completeness, Citation Validity/Support, and Final GAS, plus 17 written human-reviewer rationale notes already documenting rubric interpretation for boundary cases (zero-hit false refusal, scenario-specific reasoning, retrieval-limited comparison, BIDA-exclusivity wording). This is enough raw material to begin drafting and iterating a judge prompt.
feasibility_assessment.B_independent_holdout_feasible: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE, headcount only. A ~20/10 split is arithmetically constructible after forcing exposed families into judge_dev, but the holdout's FAILURE-CLASS diversity is severely limited -- see C.

C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.task_completion: NOT FEASIBLE independently once candidate exposure is honored (recommended); MARGINAL (2 thin, same-failure-mode families) otherwise.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.correctness: NOT FEASIBLE -- zero independent FAIL families.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.completeness: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE -- exactly 1 independent FAIL family (q002).
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.faithfulness: NOT FEASIBLE -- zero FAIL examples anywhere in the dataset.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.citation_validity: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE -- exactly 1 independent FAIL family (q013), unable to be on both sides of a split simultaneously.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.citation_support: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE -- same single family as citation_validity; the two axes have never been empirically differentiated.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.correct_abstention: NOT FEASIBLE -- zero FAIL examples anywhere.
C_per_axis_failure_validation_feasible.unsupported_answer: NOT FEASIBLE -- zero FAIL examples anywhere.

feasibility_assessment.D_final_gas_validation_feasible: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE / THIN. Only 2 of 8 GAS-FAIL-carrying families (q002, q013) are independent of rubric exposure, covering only 2 of the ~5 distinct failure modes observed in this pilot (completeness-gap and citation-mismatch; false-refusal, scenario-specific-reasoning-miss, and retrieval-limited-comparison modes have zero independent representation). A holdout GAS check built from only this pilot would validate agreement on a PASS-heavy, narrow slice of failure modes, not general judge reliability.
feasibility_assessment.20_10_split_methodologically_defensible: NOT YET, as a rigorous per-axis failure-detection validation instrument. It would be defensible only as a coarse, PASS-heavy sanity check (does the judge mostly agree with humans on the common case) plus a thin 1-2-family check on completeness and citation-mismatch specifically -- not as evidence the judge reliably detects faithfulness violations, correctness errors, false refusals, or fabricated answers to unanswerable questions, since those axes have no independent failure examples at all.
feasibility_assessment.overall_conclusion: PARTIALLY FEASIBLE. Judge DEVELOPMENT is well-supported. Judge HOLDOUT is headcount-feasible but fails to independently validate failure-detection for Correctness, Faithfulness, Correct Abstention, and Unsupported Answer (zero or fully-exposed FAIL examples), and only marginally/thinly supports Task Completion, Completeness, Citation Validity, and Citation Support (0-2 independent families each). Final GAS validation inherits this thinness.

data_gaps_if_proceeding.principle: New validation examples must come from NEW, independent question families. Generating more response variants for the same exposed (or thinly-independent) families does not create an independent holdout, and the untouched confirmatory dataset is explicitly out of scope until separately approved.

gaps_by_axis.faithfulness: Need >=2-3 new independent families with a response that asserts a claim NOT supported by its retrieved context -- currently zero exist.
gaps_by_axis.correctness: Need >=2-3 new independent families with a genuinely wrong factual claim, distinct from q019's 'range vs. specific value' failure mode.
gaps_by_axis.task_completion: Need >=2-3 new independent families demonstrating non-answer/refusal failure through a DIFFERENT mechanism than q021/q025's zero-hit-retrieval false refusal (e.g., an off-topic or evasive answer despite sufficient evidence).
gaps_by_axis.completeness: Need >=2-3 more new independent families beyond q002, ideally spanning different omission patterns (missing condition, missing value, missing one side of a comparison).
gaps_by_axis.citation_validity_vs_support: Need new independent families that separate the two failure modes: (a) a citation to a section not in the retrieved set (validity failure) with support otherwise fine, and (b) a citation to a real retrieved section that does NOT actually support the attached claim (support failure) -- currently both axes' only evidence (q013) fails on both simultaneously, so the two have never been distinguished.
gaps_by_axis.correct_abstention_and_unsupported_answe: Need >=2-3 new independent unanswerable-question families where the system response actually DOES fabricate an answer, to demonstrate the judge can catch that failure rather than only confirm correct abstentions.
gaps_by_axis.approximate_total_new_independent_famili: 8-12, distributed across the gaps above, none overlapping with the 8 already-exposed families or reusing the same underlying policy/retrieval scenario as an existing family.

label_gold_consistency_check.q007_control_and_v1_treatment_completene: TRUE -- both still omit the B-or-better requirement (q007-c05, retained in v1.1), confirmed directly from eval/annotation/pilot_30q_v2.1/gold_revision_log.md and cross-checked against eval/annotation/final_human_labels_v2.1.csv (q007 Control: completeness=FAIL, final_gas=FAIL).
label_gold_consistency_check.q027_correction_reflected_consistently: TRUE -- both Control and v1 Treatment rows for q027 show Completeness=PASS and Final GAS=PASS in the final label CSV, consistent with the correction notes on response_ids R030 and R040 in the v1 human-reviewed workbook.
label_gold_consistency_check.important_distinction: Changes in aggregate metrics (e.g. Control GAS 68%, v1 Treatment GAS 72%) caused by the q007 gold correction and the q027 label correction are EVALUATION-INSTRUMENT REVISIONS, not model-performance changes. Both corrections were applied identically to whichever arms they touched (q007's gold applies equally to Control and Treatment scoring; q027's label correction was applied to both Control and v1 Treatment), so the CONTROL-vs-TREATMENT comparison itself is not distorted by either correction -- but the ABSOLUTE percentage levels are not comparable to any hypothetical pre-correction baseline, and should not be read as evidence the underlying model or prompt changed.
